groups.instruction: Find the word from the four choices that joins to the word shown to make one new, longer word. Watch the gap: sometimes your word goes after the word given, and sometimes before it.
groups.example: Which word makes a new word when placed after “sun”?  (sun____)   table, flower, quickly, under.   “sun” and “flower” join to make “sunflower”, so the answer is flower.
